What is sphere tracing and how It works | 3D rendering guide
Mar 29, 2025Sphere Tracing is a powerful method for rendering SDF-based scenes, significantly improving the efficiency of Ray Marching. It is widely used in procedural graphics, the demoscene, and generative art, providing fast and accurate visualization of complex forms.
